## `Counters`

[source](counters.aug#L20)

**Author documentation**

The complete counter composition; its mutable state belongs to each scope.

This composition declares these providers before startup:

- Provide [`_Initial`](counters.aug.md#symbol-_Initial) when `State` is requested. Reuse one instance.
- Provide [`_Counter`](counters.aug.md#symbol-_Counter) when `Counter` is requested. Reuse one instance per explicit scope. Permit explicit shared mutation. Required dependencies: `State`.
